_comment: Upstream bulk datasets we depend on (VISION rows 84/85). Each entry records
the cache validators seen the last time we looked, so a weekly HEAD request
can tell us the file changed without downloading it.
'seen' is what upstream served at 'checked'. 'built_from' is the Last-Modified
of the copy our published data was actually built from — when the two differ,
our map is behind upstream. Set built_from when a rebuild ships.
'backup' records whether we hold our own copy. Standing rule (Tim, 2026-07-25):
assume US federal datasets can be withdrawn or quietly stop updating, so mirror
a copy when we first depend on one. Use upstream while it is there; keep the
backup so a withdrawal is an inconvenience rather than a dead feature.
Where a backup lives depends on size (Tim, 2026-07-25): <= 20 MB is better
committed into this repo, where it is versioned and cannot be lost with a
laptop; anything larger goes to ~/data/cidrlab/boondock_map, since GitHub
warns past 50 MB and refuses past 100 MB per file.
Adding a source: append an object with id/label/url/risk. The checker fills the rest.

_comment_derived: derived_data (VISION row 97): data we BUILT from other sources and committed
(no upstream Last-Modified of its own). It silently ages as OSM/Overture
improve, so we record when it was built and flag it past stale_after_days
with a 'consider rebuilding' note. Update snapshot_date when a rebuild ships.
